title: 3-Day Pune to Goa Trip Focused on Step-Free Access and Beaches
summary: This trip is designed for a traveler using a wheelchair, with a focus on step-free routes, accessible hotels, and easy access to beaches and restaurants. All places were chosen because they are likely to suit your needs, but please check accessibility details directly before booking.

traveler.notes: Budget is about 30,000 INR. Prioritize comfort, avoid stairs, and allow time for rest. Confirm accessibility and room type before booking.

days.title: Travel from Pune to Goa and Settle In

items.name: Flight: Pune to Goa (Dabolim)
items.note: Choose an airline that offers wheelchair assistance. Arrive early for support at Pune Airport.

items.name: Taxi with Luggage Assistance
items.note: Pre-book a taxi and request help with luggage and step-free access.

items.name: Check-in: Novotel Goa Resort & Spa
items.note: Request an accessible room. Rest and unpack.

items.name: Dinner at Fisherman’s Wharf
items.note: Enjoy Goan cuisine. Confirm step-free entrance and accessible restroom in advance.

days.title: Relax at the Beach and Enjoy Local Food

items.name: Visit: Miramar Beach
items.note: Choose this beach for its gentle slope and paved promenade. Check if beach wheelchairs are available.

items.name: Lunch at Ritz Classic Panaji
items.note: Try Goan thali. Confirm step-free entry and accessible restroom.

items.name: Rest at Hotel or Poolside
items.note: Enjoy hotel facilities or relax by the pool. Ask about pool lifts or ramps.

days.title: Explore More and Return to Pune

items.name: Visit: Goa State Museum
items.note: Explore local history. Confirm elevator and step-free access before visiting.

items.name: Lunch at Mum’s Kitchen
items.note: Enjoy traditional Goan dishes. Call ahead to check for ramps and accessible restrooms.

items.name: Taxi to Goa International Airport
items.note: Arrange a taxi with step-free access and luggage help.

items.name: Flight: Goa to Pune
items.note: Request wheelchair assistance for boarding and arrival at Pune.

access.summary: Pune International Airport provides wheelchair assistance, accessible restrooms, tactile paving, and accessible parking, which are important for travelers with limited mobility. However, details about step-free routes, ramps, elevators, and quiet spaces are not specified and should be confirmed.

draft.subject: Accessibility Information Request for Pune International Airport
draft.body: Hello, I am planning to travel through Pune International Airport and use a wheelchair. Could you please confirm if the airport entrance and all main routes are step-free? Are there ramps or elevators available for moving between different levels? Is there an accessible restroom after security? Can staff meet us on arrival to assist with check-in and boarding? Thank you for your help.

access.summary: Goa International Airport provides step-free access, ramps, elevators, accessible restrooms, assistance services, and accessible parking for travelers with limited mobility. Information about tactile signage, hearing loops, quiet spaces, and accessible rooms is not available.

draft.body: Hello, I am planning a stay and use a wheelchair. Could you please confirm: (1) Is the main entrance step-free? tips: Contact all hotels and restaurants in advance to confirm step-free access, ramps, and accessible restrooms.
Book flights with airlines that offer wheelchair assistance and notify them at least 48 hours before travel.
Consider traveling with a companion for extra support at beaches or public places.
Carry a list of accessible taxi services in Goa and pre-book when possible.
Plan for extra rest time each day and avoid rushing between stops.
